entries.name: Malum Caedo
entries.description: Ultramarines Sternguard Veteran from Warhammer 40,000: Boltgun. In Warhammer Survivors he parks his Boltgun and fights with a Chainsword that unleashes horizontal serrated attacks.
entries.title: Sternguard Veteran
entries.ability: Chainsword: horizontal serrated attacks that hit multiple enemies
entries.demo: Playable in the May and October demos

entries.name: Trooper Kozlowski
entries.description: Cadian Shock Trooper of the Astra Militarum's Cadian 501st. His Lasgun fires at the nearest enemy; as it levels up, squadmates join his side.
entries.title: Cadian Shock Trooper
entries.ability: Lasgun levels bring in additional squadmates (Cadian Shock Troopers)
entries.unlock: Rescued from a circle of enemies at a question-mark objective in the October demo (IGN hands-on, press)
entries.squad: Joins another champion's squad when that champion takes the Lasgun (IGN). Official combo: with the Castellan, every Cadian follower from Lasgun upgrades adds to the Castellan's damage.
entries.demo: Named in the October demo roster

entries.name: Brother Luca
entries.description: Ultramarines Space Marine Intercessor created new for Warhammer Survivors. Starts with a Boltgun; its evolved form is the Heavy Bolter.
entries.title: Space Marine Intercessor
entries.ability: Boltgun evolves into the Heavy Bolter, a stream of unrelenting firepower
entries.demo: Not named in the October demo roster

entries.name: The Legend of Catachan
entries.description: A 'One Man Army' specialising in guerrilla, hit-and-run tactics. Moves faster than other Survivors and starts armed exclusively with Frag Grenades before unlocking other weapons such as his modified Ripper Pistol.
entries.title: One Man Army
entries.ability: Higher movement speed than other Survivors
entries.unlock: Rescue encounter guarded by Tyranid Warriors using Synapse in the October demo (IGN hands-on, press)

entries.name: Marneus Calgar
entries.description: Chapter Master of the Ultramarines. Uses certain weapons only, such as the Gauntlets of Ultramar. Evolving the Power Fists weapon brings Calgar to your side (unless you are playing as him).
entries.title: Chapter Master of the Ultramarines
entries.starting_weapon: Gauntlets of Ultramar (signature weapon named; starting loadout pending launch)
entries.squad: Keyword-restricted: other champions get Calgar as a follower via the Power Fists evolution.

entries.name: Knight-Commander Pask
entries.description: Astra Militarum tank ace who commands his Leman Russ battle tank.
entries.title: Knight-Commander

entries.name: Commissar Sebastian Yarrick
entries.description: The legendary Commissar, named as playable on the Steam store page.
entries.title: Commissar

entries.name: Chaplain Fo'Baran
entries.description: Salamanders Chaplain named among the Warhammer 40,000 heroes by Warhammer Community.
entries.title: Salamanders Chaplain

entries.name: Morvenn Vahl
entries.description: High Abbess Sanctorum of the Adepta Sororitas, one of the larger characters, striding in her Paragon Warsuit. Heavy Bolter Fidelis sprays an arc of projectiles and can trigger a miracle that raises its rate of fire.
entries.title: High Abbess Sanctorum
entries.ability: Fidelis has a chance to trigger a miracle, blessing Vahl and increasing the weapon's rate of fire

entries.name: The Castellan
entries.description: Black Templars Castellan whose attack power and skill increase with every follower gained.
entries.title: Black Templars Castellan
entries.ability: Attack power and skill scale with the number of followers
entries.squad: Official combo: pair with Trooper Kozlowski — each Cadian Shock Trooper from Lasgun upgrades contributes to the Castellan's damage.

entries.name: Demetrian Titus
entries.description: Space Marine 2's Demetrian Titus makes a brief appearance in the Skulls trailer. Whether he is playable has not been stated.
entries.title: Trailer appearance

entries.name: Neave Blacktalon
entries.description: Stormcast Eternal, a living weapon of Sigmar who storms into battle in a torrent of whirling axe swings. The axes eventually evolve into whirling blades of arcing lightning.
entries.title: Living weapon of Sigmar
entries.starting_weapon: Tempest Axes (October demo, IGN); the November 2025 reveal calls her starter the Whirlwind Axes
entries.demo: Playable in the May and October demos

entries.name: Sharynn Azurwrath
entries.description: Stormcast Eternal Vanquisher. Starts battle with a Grandblade which, when levelled up, unleashes a huge circular swing.
entries.title: Stormcast Eternal Vanquisher
entries.ability: Grandblade level-ups add a huge circular cleave
entries.demo: Not named in the October demo roster

entries.name: Gotrek Gurnisson
entries.description: The legendary Slayer. Wields Zangrom-Thaz, which other champions obtain by evolving the Fyrestorm Greataxe — that evolution calls Gotrek to your side.
entries.title: The Realmslayer
entries.starting_weapon: Zangrom-Thaz (signature weapon; starting loadout pending launch)
entries.squad: Keyword-restricted. Other champions get Gotrek as a follower via the Fyrestorm Greataxe evolution; playing as Gotrek, the evolution does not spawn a clone.
entries.demo: Not named in the October demo roster

entries.name: Ulgromthier
entries.description: Auric Runemaster and high priest of a Fyreslayer forge-temple. Starts each battle with a higher health pool and fires arcing magma projectiles from his Brazier Staff.
entries.title: Auric Runemaster
entries.demo: Named in the October demo roster

entries.name: Lyssa Revenya
entries.description: Thief and tomb-robber of the Saviours of Cinderfall. Her Rope and Grapnel shoots hooks in from random screen edges, restraining enemies, often instantly killing weaker foes and dragging survivors away.
entries.title: Saviour of Cinderfall
entries.ability: Rope and Grapnel evolves into the Ghost of Rhea

entries.name: Bastian Carthalos
entries.description: Wields Uskavar the Sunderer, striking out in specific close-range patterns.
entries.title: Pending launch
entries.squad: Official combo: with Lorai, whose Nebulous Sea Fog draws enemies into Bastian's close-range damage zones.

entries.name: Lorai, Child of the Abyss
entries.description: Conjures Nebulous Sea Fog that draws foes in and damages them.
entries.title: Child of the Abyss
entries.squad: Official combo: pull enemies into Bastian Carthalos's close-range attacks.
